issues.problem: Distractor が after the quoted clause (届いたが伝えてください) can be read as the conjunction 'but', so it is not plainly ungrammatical.
issues.action: Replaced distractor が with で (届いたで伝えて is ungrammatical); d is now を, に, で.

issues.problem: English '<who> <event> <when> too' is ambiguous: 'came to the party yesterday too' reads as 'yesterday as well' (昨日も), not 'my mother as well' (母も).
issues.action: Changed en to '<who> also <event> <when>.' so 'also' clearly attaches to the subject.
